OprCounter.title: OprCounter
OprCounter.description: Tracks the global total number of One Page Reports (OPR) generated across all devices.

totalGenerated.description: Cumulative count of OPRs generated across all devices.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last counter update.

/counters/{counterId}.description: Global singleton counter document (counterId == 'global') syncing total OPRs generated across devices.
